raw_definitions: Definisi : pineapples are expensive in England but here they are ten a ~, buah nanas mahal di England tetapi berlambak-lambak di sini; actresses are ten a ~ in Hollywood, aktres-aktres bersepah-sepah di Hollywood. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : turning up like a bad ~ ( colloq ) asyik datang menyibuk: the salesman kept turning up like a bad ~, jurujual itu asyik datang menyibuk; /not have, without/ a ~ to o’s name, tdk ada duit langsung; a pretty ~, sejumlah wang yg besar: a thousand pounds is a pretty ~ to spend on such a trifling thing, bayaran sebanyak seribu paun ialah satu jumlah yg besar utk barang-barang yg kurang penting spt itu; spend a ~, ( euphem ) pergi ke tandas awam; /two, ten/, (for) a ~, ( colloq ) in abundance, berlambak-lambak, bersepah-sepah: (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : pennies from heaven, ( colloq ) durian runtuh, rezeki datang bergolek, duit terpijak; a ~ for your thoughts, ( colloq ) apa yg kamu /fikirkan, menungkan/; the ~ ( has ) dropped, ( colloq ) dapat menangkap sst, faham: finally, the ~ dropped and he joined in the laughter, akhirnya, dia dapat menangkap maksudnya dan turut sama ketawa; /earn, turn/ an honest ~, mencari /duit, rezeki/ yg halal: I’m just an ordinary businessman trying to earn an honest ~, saya hanya seorang peniaga biasa yg mencuba mencari duit yg halal; keep (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. small amount of money, sen: the trip won’t cost you a ~ if you come with us, kamu tdk perlu mengeluarkan satu sen pun kalau kamu menyertai kami dlm perjalanan itu; he saves every ~ he earns, dia menyimpan setiap sen yg diperolehnya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. British coin, peni: it will be worth anything from a ~ to a hundred pounds, barang itu mungkin bernilai antara satu peni hingga ke seratus paun; I paid eighteen pence for it, saya membayar lapan belas peni utk barang itu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
